subject: Quick coordination: demo window change and SE coverage
body:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan@vidrosys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick coordination: demo window change and SE coverage

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for booking time with us. I wanted to confirm we have your slot on Wed, Sep 8 at 11:00 AM PT for a 45-minute product walkthrough. Quick note: Marissa (our SE) just flagged a travel overlap that week, so I want to give you full visibility and offer two options so we avoid any last-minute scrambling.

Option A — keep the time, and Karthik (SE) will cover the demo; Marissa will join for the Q&A segment remotely.
Option B — move to Thu, Sep 9 at 10:00 AM PT so Marissa can own the full walkthrough in-person.

I attached the latest deck and a mutual action plan; either option works for our team — which do you prefer? If neither, share a couple of alternative windows and we’ll pivot.

Thanks,
Naomi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

[attachment: Vidro-demo-deck-v2.pdf (pdf), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Lee <jordan@vidrosys.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 08:39:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick coordination: demo window change and SE coverage

On Tue, Sep 1, 2026 at 08:12 Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Jordan —
> 
> Thanks again for booking time with us. I wanted to confirm we have your slot on Wed, Sep 8 at 11:00 AM PT for a 45-minute product walkthrough. Quick note: Marissa (our SE) just flagged a travel overlap that week, so I want to give you full visibility and offer two options so we avoid any last-minute scrambling.

Sorry — I completely forgot I’m on a customer on-site the morning of Sep 8 and won’t be back in time for the walk-through. I can be available after 2:00 PM PT on Sep 8 (remote) or full-day Sep 9 (in-person). If Jordan prefers Karthik to run the full demo, I’m happy to hand off and do a thorough prep this week.

Recommend: Karthik runs the demo if Jordan wants the earlier slot; otherwise, move to Sep 9 for uninterrupted coverage.

-Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Lee <jordan@vidrosys.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick coordination: demo window change and SE coverage

Happy to cover Sep 8 at 11:00 AM PT. I can run the end-to-end walkthrough and ensure Marissa joins for the last 10–15 minutes for the deeper architecture Q&A. I’ll sync with Marissa today to get up to speed on the custom ask around data retention.

If Jordan wants the in-person energy from Marissa, we should move to Sep 9 — either way I’ll prep.

-Karthik
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Lee <jordan@vidrosys.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick coordination: demo window change and SE coverage

Thanks for the heads up, Naomi / Marissa. We’d prefer to keep Sep 8 at 11:00 AM PT — earlier works better for our execs. Karthik covering is fine; happy to have Marissa join for the last 15 minutes for the architecture deep-dive.

Can Karthik run through the specific data retention flow and the audit-log examples? Also confirm if you can send the calendar invite (.ics) that includes a dial-in and (if possible) a short agenda.

--Jordan
Director of IT Operations | Vidro Systems
jordan@vidrosys.com | +1 (617) 555-2201

[external note: Vidro requests SOC2-specific examples during the technical Q&A — flagging for SE prep]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan@vidrosys.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick coordination: demo window change and SE coverage

Perfect — keeping Sep 8 at 11:00 AM PT and Karthik will lead. I’ve attached the calendar invite and updated the agenda to call out: 1) high-level product tour (25m), 2) data retention + audit logs (15m), 3) Q&A — SOC 2 examples (5m) with Marissa dropping in.

Karthik — I uploaded two prep notes to Drive (link below) and added a short line in the mutual action plan about SOC2 evidence to prepare. Marissa — if you have a one-slide example about audit log exports, can you add it to the deck by EOD?

Invite: [attachment: calendar-invite.ics]
Prep links: https://drive.redwood.com/s/vidro-demo-notes
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/contact/67890

Thanks everyone — see you Sep 8.

Naomi
